svg.metadata: {"id": "s102", "name": "秋收田野·秸秆禁烧", "cat": "季节专题", "tags": ["安全", "秸秆禁烧", "农村", "秋收", "秋天"], "desc": "秋收后的田野：金色麦田与收割后的茬地、圆柱草卷和尖顶秸秆垛、挂满玉米串的农家小院与柿子树、禁止焚烧秸秆标牌。", "stand": {"ground_y": 870, "x": [560, 1380]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "sky", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": 0}, {"name": "clouds", "enter": "slide-r", "delay": 0.15, "loop": "drift", "depth": 0.05}, {"name": "hills", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.25, "loop": null, "depth": 0.15}, {"name": "field", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.35, "loop": null, "depth": 0.5}, {"name": "house", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.5, "loop": null, "depth": 0.4}, {"name": "persimmon", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.65, "loop": null, "depth": 0.42}, {"name": "straw", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.8, "loop": null, "depth": 0.62}, {"name": "sign", "enter": "pop", "delay": 1.0, "loop": null, "depth": 0.85}, {"name": "near", "enter": "rise", "delay": 1.05, "loop": null, "depth": 1}, {"name": "falling", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.2, "loop": "fall", "depth": 0.9}], "palette": {"sky1": "#86C3EA", "sky2": "#FFEBC9", "sun": "#FFF1C9", "hill": "#D9B97A", "hill2": "#C9A161", "field": "#F2C653", "field2": "#E3AA3A", "stub": "#C99A48", "stub2": "#B07F35", "straw": "#F5D27A", "straw2": "#D9A84A", "straw3": "#B5822F", "t1": "#F6B930", "t2": "#FFD95A", "t3": "#E07A22", "t4": "#D9542B", "trunk": "#7A4E33", "trunk2": "#5E3A26", "wall": "#F3E6CF", "wall2": "#DCC7A6", "roof": "#8F4A36", "roof2": "#6E3626", "door": "#9C5C3A", "corn": "#F7B528", "corn2": "#E08A1B", "pers": "#F07A2A", "post": "#7F4C2C", "board": "#F9F3E3", "red": "#E2382F", "fl": "#F2622E", "fl2": "#FFB238", "smoke": "#B9A99A"}}
